title: Pool Worker Execution Context
description: Launcher-owned per-attempt execution marker. Version 3 extends v2 with private Pi runtime/session roots, executable/package/profile identity, selected approved model, tool grants, and result destination required for the Pool Proof vertical slice. The supervisor is the only permitted issuer; the worker treats every field as untrusted until preflight validates it against this schema and against launcher-supplied expectations.

attempt_nonce.description: Single-use launcher-generated value. Reuse identifies a replayed launch context.

issued_by.description: Trusted issuer. v3 accepts both the supervisor and the runtime launcher that actually mints Pool Proof markers.

expires_at.description: Launcher-owned absolute expiry. Preflight rejects the attempt at or after this instant regardless of max_age_seconds.

max_age_seconds.description: Launcher-owned freshness budget. The orchestrator specification fixes a five-minute ceiling; a launcher may be stricter and never laxer.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the ephemeral per-attempt workspace this context is bound to.

pi_runtime_parent.description: Absolute path of the launcher-owned private Pi runtime parent directory.

pi_session_dir.description: Absolute path of the fresh Pi session directory for this attempt.

selected_model.description: Approved builder model selected by the launcher before spawn.
